sprites.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. From the provided APPROVED Naoto character sheet, create ONE individual full-body FRONT-FACING standing Naoto sprite, based precisely on the first small basic front view in the lower middle row. Preserve this same approved man's wavy center-parted dark brown hair, gentle dark eyes, small friendly CLOSED-MOUTH smile, light skin, white/light grey zip hoodie over charcoal shirt, dark navy trousers and dark shoes. Both arms resting naturally at sides, both hands and both feet clearly visible. Same cute head-body proportions and crisp stepped pixel style. Do not create a new person; do not add a crown, props, words, additional faces, sheet panels, actual photographs, border or signature. This is the normal single author sprite, not the toothy ending portrait. Fit complete hair, head, hoodie, hands and shoes with at least 8% free margin on all sides of a square canvas. Genuine transparent background. Intended final export is 128x128 pixels. One character, one frame.

revisions.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit ONLY the background of this exact approved Naoto sprite. Remove every grey/white checkerboard square and replace all background with perfectly flat solid vivid green #00FF00, including the gap between the legs and inside elbow/hair gaps. This green is a working background, NOT any part of the character. Preserve the exact existing character's full hair outline, face, gentle closed mouth, skin, white-grey hoodie, charcoal shirt, navy trousers, hands and shoes, all original details, same size and position. Do not recolor any white clothing to green. Do not redraw, restyle, crop or change pose or expression. One sprite only. No checkers, gradients, shadows, text, panels, letters or added objects.

sprites.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished standalone game sprite for the Japanese virtual-pet game Naotocchi. Clean cute Japanese pixel art, matching a polished 128x128 game asset enlarged without smoothing: clearly stepped dark colored outlines, compact clustered pixel shading, a restrained palette, friendly expressive readable eyes and mouth, subtle blush. Full body completely visible, a single character with no other characters; keep every ear, limb, toe and tail inside canvas with generous blank margins on all sides. Roughly 80-85% of the square canvas occupied. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no checkerboard printed into background, no shadow plate, no ground scenery, no text, labels, letters, numbers, UI or watermark. Distinct from a grey sitting player cat and a formal black cat CEO. No box obscuring its body, no collar, no props.
